```yaml
name: Skills Build and Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: golangci-lint run

      - name: Build the operator
        run: go build ./cmd/thv-operator/...

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: go test -v ./pkg/...

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test -v ./integration/...

  publish:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: golangci-lint run

      - name: Build the operator
        run: go build ./cmd/thv-operator/...

      - name: Push Docker image
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}" | docker login -u "${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}" --password-stdin
          docker tag thv-operator:latest ${{ secrets.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
          docker push ${{ secrets.DOCKER_IMAGE }}:latest
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file is designed to build and publish the `thv-operator` binary for the `stacklok/toolhive` repository. It includes steps for checking out the code, setting up Go, installing dependencies, running linters, building the operator, and pushing the Docker image to a registry. The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
